Definition: properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free)
BiblicalUsage: yether stands behind the English phrase the remainder, what is left. In Genesis 49:3, the excellency of dignity, and it appears again in Exodus 10:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe yether still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
